items.scientificReason: Charges and locations of proton, neutron and electron are compact foundations needed to interpret and communicate atom models. Keep existing memory requirement/card for the retained particle option. Scattering-to-kernel inference is conceptual and has no added recall quota.

Model structure, neighbour count and property effects are reconstructed from supplied ion/model information. No fixed lattice types, coordination-number table or instant formula recall is required; explaining mobility/attraction is assessed as understanding.
Selected metal/compound identity and property information are supplied. The evidence is a substance-specific property/use justification; no catalogue of salts or industrial uses is memorized.
Reaction observations and substance/product information are supplied. The comparison of hydrogen formation and shared hydroxide formation is causal understanding, not a bare equation recital.
Selected observations, substance identities and uses are supplied. Distinguishing element and compound and justifying the use is reasoning; no complete halogen-use catalogue or factual-name quota.

A supplied process scheme makes substances and steps available. Sulfur capture/oxidation/gypsum formation is a traced explanation; no plant equation or technical process table must be instantly recalled.

Nutrient ions, plant need, fertilizer quantity and transport conditions are supplied for a conditional judgment. No fertilizer catalogue, application rate or environmental threshold recall is made normative.
